citations.claim: cart exceeds track limit at first violating step
cart already near edge and moving outward one step before
cart steadily drifting outward mid-run with positive velocity

counterfactual.change: set initial cart velocity v from 0.3067 to 0.0; cart no longer drifts off track

explanation: Controller keeps pole balanced (theta ~0.08 rad, small force ~0.87N) but does not return cart to center: cart starts at x=0.44 with v=0.31 outward and maintains positive velocity (~0.6-1.37 m/s) throughout, drifting monotonically until x=2.404 exceeds 2.4 at step 261. Zeroing initial velocity removes the failure, confirming outward drift/weak cart-position regulation as cause.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.404 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart sits at the far right end of the track with the pole still nearly upright. From step 258 to 261 it drifts further right past the track edge while balance is maintained.
